subject: Air freight quote request: HAM to BOG
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Could you please quote an all-in price in EUR for the cheapest air freight option from HAM to BOG (Bogota, CO)? We will deliver the shipment to HAM ourselves, so no pickup is needed. The shipment will be ready on 2026-11-28.

The shipment consists of 3 pieces of laboratory glassware, with a total gross weight of 630 kg and a volume of 3.96 cbm.

Thank you in advance for your quote.

Mit freundlichen Gruessen / Kind regards
Jonas Kessler
Logistics Coordinator
Kessler Feinmechanik GmbH, Ulm

classification.reasoning: The customer is requesting an all-in air freight quote for a specified shipment.
